name: Archive Viewer
description: Browse archives in Orca's editor tabs: .zip, .jar, .apk, .whl, .epub and other ZIP files, .tar, and .gz, .bz2, .xz or .zst (also .tar.gz and friends). A fast file tree with sizes and dates, a filter, previews of the text, images and hex inside, nested archives, legacy code page names and saving single files. Read-only, offline.

cover.alt: A ZIP in Archive Viewer: the file tree with sizes and dates on the left, its README with line numbers and details on the right.

screenshots.alt: src/index.ts from a ZIP with Orca's light theme: the src folder open in the tree, the file with line numbers, compression method, CRC-32 and encoding.
screenshots.caption: Read text and code inside an archive without unpacking it.

screenshots.alt: public/hero.png selected in the archive tree with Orca's dark theme, previewed on a checkerboard with its dimensions, 480 × 300.
screenshots.caption: Images inside the archive preview in place.

screenshots.caption: Open an archive inside an archive; binary files show as hex.
